topic: Andrés Escobar's 1994 World Cup own goal and the shooting that followed ten days later
title: He Scored An Own Goal, Then Was Shot Six Times Ten Days Later
description: The tragic true story behind Andrés Escobar's infamous 1994 World Cup own goal, and the shooting that followed just ten days later. Original AI narrated commentary based on independently sourced reporting, not a copy of any existing video.

hook_candidates.text: World Cup story that ends with a man shot six times.
One World Cup own goal ended with a professional athlete shot dead.
Most people think missing a play just costs you the game, not your life.
What's the worst that can happen after one bad play in a soccer game? For this defender, it was six bullets.

sources.note: Confirms Escobar was shot in Medellín ten days after his own goal; motive never conclusively proven.
